title: BMB Beach Music 30A Santa Rosa Beach, Florida 30A Vacay
description_expanded: Overview6 Seater Golf Cart, 3 Bikes, Public Beach - 3 Minute Bike Ride, Heated Community Pool `Beach Music 30A`The SpaceHOME HIGHLIGHTS:*4 Minutes golf cart or bike ride to beach*Walking distance to many restaurants*Parking for 2 cars*6-Seater golf cart*3 bikes included*Beach gear in outdoor closet*New Ms. Pacman arcade game*Large outdoor area with games*Great location*Fast free Wifi*Professionally managed, 24/7 serviceWelcome to Beach Music 30A - your new vacation destination! Only 4 minutes on bike or golf cart to public beach access which includes seasonal life guards, parking, bathrooms, beach chair rentals. Also enjoy access to the Blue Mountain Beach Club which features a pool, workout facility and shuffleboard.This beautiful coastal beach home is perfect for making wonderful beach memories! The home is in Blue Mountain Beach on a quiet street just south of the famous, scenic, Hwy 30A. The Beach, Restaurants and Shopping are within walking distance including the popular Blue Mountain Beach Creamery.As you walk through the doors you will be greeted by the open concept living room, kitchen and dining. The kitchen is fully stocked with everything you need to whip up your family’s favorite meal! The living room provides plenty of seating to curl up and watch a movie. A dining area is open to the kitchen and family room. On the first floor you will find a guest bedroom with queen sized bed and shared bathroom. This home includes 5 flat screen TVs with tons of channels as well as fast wifi.The spacious, fenced in backyard includes a patio with sitting area for the adults to enjoy a glass of wine, as well as outdoor games, a grill, and an outdoor shower. Check out the Beach Gear closet, with chairs and beach toys!Head upstairs and you will find the other two bedrooms. The oversized Master suite boasts a king-sized bed, desk area and private bathroom. Enjoy morning coffee off of your own balcony. The bunk room has a set of twin over full bunk beds with a pull-out twin trundle as well as a private bathroom. The bunk room also has balcony access! Full size washer and dryer are also located upstairs. The location can’t be beat! You are far enough away from the overwhelming crowds of Seaside, close enough for a quick bike ride to Gulf Place or the funky area of Grayton Beach!House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**Beach access is located at Blue Mountain Regional at Hwy 83 (0.8 miles)**CALL FOR MONTHLY SNOWBIRD RATES**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (10)Master Bedroom - Second Floor - King sized bed, private bathroomGuest Bedroom - First Floor - Queen sized bed, shared bathroomBunk Room -Second Floor - Twin over Full bunk bed with twin trundle, private bathroom (2 Twins, 1 Full)Common Area - Full sized sofa sleeperGolf Carts: IMPORTANT INFORMATION BELOW:-To operate the golf cart, guests must have a valid drivers license and be at least 21 years old.-Please be aware of the golf cart rules and regulations-A copy of the golf carts terms and conditions will be emailed upon reservation and will require signatures**Golf cart is not guaranteed. Should the golf cart need to be serviced, a backup golf cart will not be provided and no compensation given.**PLEASE NOTE - ** FL law states that any underage and/or unlicensed driver of a street legal golf cart is considered a criminal offense and a $500 fine including a possible 60 days in jail. It’s a very serious offense for underage/unlicensed driving of a LSV in the State of FL.**Show less
